requirements.quote: The runner computes the metrics on the synthetic set and writes a JSON and Markdown report.
The CI job fails on an injected ranking regression.

(Human part tracked in #899; not required for merge) At least 50 real queries come from the advocate cohort: fact patterns (for example, medical negligence with a post-operative infection and no consent) and statute queries (for example, s.37 NDPS bail with a commercial quantity). Relevant judgments are graded by an advocate.
requirements.why: Needs advocate-written, advocate-graded queries; tracked in open issue #899 and explicitly not required for merge.

requirements.quote: Dataset format: a query, optional facets, and judged relevant judgment ids with grades 0–3.
Runner: nDCG@10 and recall@50 for retrieval, and quote and citation faithfulness for answers (each quote must match segment text, and each cited id must exist).
Pinned corpus sample manifest: sha256 list.
A synthetic starter set (about 15 queries over the fixture corpus) so CI runs now.
The real set lives privately (env `RESEARCH_EVAL_PRIVATE_DIR`) and is reported separately, like `ADAPTER_PRIVATE_FIXTURES_DIR`.
A CI job, `research-eval`, in the fast tier on changes to `packages/intelligence/src/research/**` or `corpus/**`. It fails on a regression of more than 2 nDCG points against the committed baseline.
requirements.evidence: the research-eval job in .github/workflows/research-eval.yml measures it on PRs; the comparison logic itself is unit-tested in lane

deliverables.change: Dataset, corpus segment, judgment grade (0-3), Ranker, answer and report types; zod schemas for the dataset and corpus files.
ndcgAtK (gain 2^g-1, log2 discount) and recallAtK over judged relevant ids (grade>=1), plus means.
Quote faithfulness (whitespace-normalised substring of the cited segment) and citation existence checks.
Compute and verify the sha256 manifest of corpus files; fail on drift.

Load the dataset and corpus, verify the manifest, run a Ranker, compute metrics, load the optional RESEARCH_EVAL_PRIVATE_DIR set and report it separately (never gated), compare to the baseline with a 0.02 nDCG@10 tolerance.
Render the JSON and Markdown reports.
Deterministic BM25 lexical ranker over the synthetic corpus, the system under test until the real retriever lands.
CLI entry: run, write reports to an output dir, exit non-zero on regression; flag to rewrite the baseline.
Unit tests: metrics on hand-computed values, faithfulness, manifest drift, report files written, and an injected-regression test where a degraded ranker fails the baseline comparison.
Barrel for the research package (eval exports).
Synthetic fixture corpus of fictional judgments split into page-anchored segments.
About 15 synthetic queries (fact-pattern and statute) with facets and graded judgments 0-3.
sha256 list pinning corpus.json and queries.json.
Committed baseline metrics produced by the baseline ranker.
Add script research-eval running the CLI with node/tsx-free type stripping consistent with the other eval scripts; no new dependencies.

Workflow with job research-eval on pull_request paths packages/intelligence/src/research/**, packages/intelligence/src/corpus/**, fixtures/research-eval/**; runs the eval CLI, uploads the JSON and Markdown reports, fails on regression. Pinned action SHAs copied from ci.yml, setup action reused, permissions contents: read.
Add a Research eval row to the workflows table and a short paragraph on the baseline, tolerance and private set.

preserve.what: The required ci.yml job names lint, typecheck, test, build and tenancy (.github/workflows/ci.yml, docs/engineering/ci.md).
Existing @causedeck/intelligence public exports in packages/intelligence/src/index.ts and the corpus barrel packages/intelligence/src/corpus/index.ts.
The voice eval at packages/intelligence/eval/voice/ and the `eval` script in packages/intelligence/package.json.

validate.command: pnpm --filter @causedeck/intelligence exec vitest run src/research/eval/runner.test.ts src/index.test.ts src/corpus --maxWorkers=${FORGE_HOST_PARALLELISM:-1}

decisions.choice: Separate workflow research-eval.yml with a paths filter instead of a job in ci.yml
decisions.justification: ci.yml has no path-filter mechanism and its job names are required checks; lint-workflows.yml:3-9 is the path-scoped workflow precedent.

decisions.choice: Runner takes a Ranker interface and ships a BM25 baseline ranker
decisions.justification: No retrieval implementation exists yet (src/research absent), and ADR 0051:154-158 requires the gate before the retriever; the real hybrid retriever plugs in later.

decisions.choice: Private set via RESEARCH_EVAL_PRIVATE_DIR reported separately and never gated in CI
